offering_description.value: Provides software and analytics that measure the quality of digital advertising, including viewability, brand safety and fraud detection. Sold to advertisers, agencies and publishers, and delivered mainly as a software platform with usage-based fees.

primary_products.value: ad verification software; viewability measurement; brand safety tools; ad fraud detection

primary_services.value: campaign measurement; analytics reporting; media quality consulting

customer_segment.value: B2B: advertisers, ad agencies, publishers and digital media platforms

end_markets.value: digital advertising; media and publishing; retail; consumer goods

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: fees per measured ad impression; subscription: platform access and software licenses for customers

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: measurement platform that takes ad impression data and sells verification results to advertisers and publishers

geography_served.value: global: customers in North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other regions

specialization.value: niche specialist: digital ad verification and measurement only

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: enterprise sales teams selling to brands and agencies; partners / resellers: integrations with ad buying platforms and ad servers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data privacy rules such as GDPR and CCPA apply to user-level ad data
